errorRules.message: W&B Inference rejected the credentials (HTTP 401). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Create a key at {setupUrl}. The vendor's 401 article (https://docs.wandb.ai/support/inference/articles/api-error-code-401-authentication-failed) lists an invalid, expired or revoked API key and an incorrect W&B project entity or name as causes.

W&B Inference reports the quota is exceeded (HTTP 402). The vendor's 402 article (https://docs.wandb.ai/support/inference/articles/api-error-code-402-you-exceeded-your-cur) says this means no remaining credits or a reached monthly spending cap; see https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/usage-limits

errorRules.message: W&B Inference returned "Country, region, or territory not supported" (HTTP 403). The vendor's article (https://docs.wandb.ai/support/inference/articles/api-error-code-403-country-region-or-ter) says the service determines location from the IP address of the request; see https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/usage-limits#geographic-restrictions

errorRules.message: W&B Inference returned "The inference gateway is not enabled for your organization" (HTTP 403). The vendor's article (https://docs.wandb.ai/support/inference/articles/api-error-code-403-the-inference-gateway) says to ask your organization's W&B administrator to enable the inference gateway.

W&B Inference returned HTTP 404 for model '{model}'. The vendor's 404 article (https://docs.wandb.ai/support/inference/articles/api-error-code-404-model-not-found) says model IDs are case-sensitive; the ids are listed at https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/models

W&B Inference rate-limit error. The vendor's 429 article (https://docs.wandb.ai/support/inference/articles/api-error-code-429-concurrency-limit-rea) covers a 429 with the message "Concurrency limit reached for requests" and lists reducing concurrent requests as one approach; limits are described at https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/usage-limits

instructions: 1. Visit: https://app.wandb.ai/login?signup=true and sign up for a W&B account (https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/prerequisites)

2. Create an API key: click your user profile icon, then User Settings, then Create new API key, and copy it immediately because W&B shows the full key once (https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/prerequisites); the API reference also names https://wandb.ai/settings (https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/api-reference)

3. Project: the prerequisites page (https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/prerequisites) lists a W&B project among the items you must have: "Create a project in your W&B account to track usage." The chat completions reference (https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/api-reference/chat-completions) lists "Your W&B team and project: [YOUR-TEAM]/[YOUR-PROJECT] (optional)."

4. Credits: "Serverless Inference credits come with Free, Pro, and Academic plans for a limited time." Free accounts must activate pay-as-you-go inference on the Billing tab or upgrade to a paid plan when credits run out; the default cap for a Free account is $100/month (https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/usage-limits)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.inference.wandb.ai/v1 (https://docs.wandb.ai/inference: "Serverless Inference gives you access to leading open-source foundation models through W&B Weave and an OpenAI-compatible API."). Docs-verified only: GET https://api.inference.wandb.ai/v1/models answers HTTP 401 without a key, so the 12 model ids (from the 20 in the models page's "Generally available models" table) come from https://docs.wandb.ai/inference/models, retrieved 2026-09-29, and the roster has not been checked; the entry is not yet live-verified. Context windows are the contextWindow values returned by the vendor's public catalog API (GET https://trace.wandb.ai/inference/catalog/models, documented at https://docs.wandb.ai/weave/reference/service-api/inference/inference-catalog-models as "This API is available without authentication."); prices come from https://wandb.ai/site/pricing/tokens/. models.defaultContextWindow (128000) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (8192) are placeholders: the vendor does not publish a general default or a maximum output figure. errorRules follow the statuses and messages on https://docs.wandb.ai/support/inference and the 401 body observed on 2026-09-29.
